description.value: Chez Christophe is a Swiss-inspired chocolaterie and patisserie founded by Swiss-trained pastry chef Christophe Bonzon, with this White Rock location opening in 2019. The shop offers handcrafted artisan chocolates, freshly baked croissants and pastries, custom cakes, and a full espresso café bar using locally roasted beans from Pallet Coffee Roasters. A rewarding stop for touring cyclists seeking quality coffee or an indulgent chocolate treat along the Johnston Road corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 67m; rack at 80m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the White Rock branch of Chez Christophe at 1558 Johnston Road with phone 604.385.4474, matching the OSM address. The café beverages page confirms espresso drinks and pastries are served in-store at the White Rock location, and the site prominently features store pickup, confirming takeout. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities was found anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record lists no phone number; website contact page confirms 604.385.4474 for the White Rock location — phone populated from website.
OSM community field is tagged 'Tsawwassen' but the address (1558 Johnston Road, V4B 3Z7) is in White Rock — may be a community assignment error in OSM.
